title: Choose the hybrid approach
author: claude
summary: A fast live view while people interact, with the room's light calculated in advance.
what: We agreed a two-part plan: a fast live view for moving around, and photo-quality light calculated ahead of time.
why: Light that is calculated in advance costs nothing while the page runs, and still looks photo-real.
how:
- While the visitor moves around, a fast live view draws the scene.
- Later, a path tracer will refine the picture to photo quality within one to three seconds, once the view stops moving.
- The room's light is calculated in advance in Blender and saved as pictures, plus one 360-degree picture of the room. The table and chairs are lit live from that 360-degree picture.
